basis: ADM’s Q2 earnings release was the earliest qualifying communication found. Its Consolidated Statements of Earnings report revenue of $25,190 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2023, against $27,284 million for the prior-year quarter. Revenue fell 7.67%, below the $25,919.8 million cutoff. The earlier releases, presentations and management remarks reviewed gave no numeric upper bound for Q2 consolidated revenue.

coverage.detail: July 26, 2022. The original Q2 2022 release reported consolidated quarterly revenue of $27,284 million, matching the comparative figure in the Q2 2023 release.
January 26, 2023. The Q4 2022 release reported December-quarter and full-year results and gave a qualitative outlook for 2023. It supplied no June-quarter consolidated revenue forecast.
January 26 earnings call. Management discussed 2023 crush margins, Nutrition operating profit growth and scenarios for segment performance. Those measures supplied no Q2 consolidated sales ceiling.
April 25. The preceding earnings release reported consolidated revenue of $24,072 million for the quarter ended March 31. It gave no corresponding forecast for the June quarter.
April 25 earnings presentation. Its numerical crush-margin ranges describe regional soybean-processing economics. They do not specify ADM’s Q2 revenue.

April 25 earnings call. Management expected lower year-over-year Q2 crushing results and ethanol margins, and Q2 profit growth in Human Nutrition. Its companywide $6–$7 range was full-year earnings per share.
May 8. The intervening Form 8-K reported shareholder votes at the May 4 annual meeting under Item 5.07. It contained no preliminary quarterly results or sales guidance.
May 17 BMO conference. CFO Vikram Luthar reiterated the $6–$7 full-year EPS range. His remarks supplied no numeric Q2 consolidated revenue forecast.

May 31 Bernstein conference. CEO Juan Luciano described ADM as an approximately $100 billion revenue company while discussing the prior record year. He gave no June-quarter consolidated revenue range.
July 12. ADM announced that it would release Q2 results before the market opened July 25. The scheduling notice contained no preliminary sales figure.
July 25. ADM published both GAAP revenue figures together in the quarter-ended June 30 columns of its consolidated earnings table. The adjacent six-month columns report separate year-to-date amounts.

publication_date_evidence: ADM’s investor-relations results announcement displays July 25, 2023 as its publication date. Exhibit 99.1 independently carries the same Chicago dateline and identifies June 30, 2023 as the quarter end.
